The main takeaway from our work is that
we have shown that CD151 is an important cell surface protein in high-grade serous cancer and that it is associated with poor prognosis.
we identified a subset of HGCS cell lines that depend on the expression of the tetraspan CD151 for survival, and that this dependency can be exploited therapeutically.
we have identified a novel therapeutic target in a subset of high-grade seroous ovarian cancer (a type of ovarian cancer) called CD151.
